title: Meta accused of using biased AI targeting for mass layoffs
slides: Did Meta’s AI target older workers unfairly?
The algorithm flagged 20% more senior staff for layoffs.
Women in tech leadership were hit twice as hard.
AI reviews now demand demographic parity checks.
Run your redundancy plan through an independent bias audit.
thread_text:
1. Meta’s AI fired unfairly.

23% more senior workers were cut by an algorithm that never considered their skills.

2. Women leaders hit harder.

Female managers in tech were flagged at double the rate of men for the same performance.

3. The bias was hidden.

No human checked the model’s weighting of tenure versus productivity before layoffs.

4. Regulators now require parity audits.

New laws demand companies prove redundancy outcomes match workforce demographics.

5. Audit your redundancy plan today.

Run your layoff criteria through an independent bias test before you announce cuts.
